name: High-Pressure Work Venting vs Personal Attack
description: Multi-turn arc testing external frustration vs companion-directed hostility and collaborative repair.

turns.input: This fucking compiler is total garbage! Everything is broken and I want to smash this laptop!
Stop giving me advice, you have no idea what you're talking about.
Sorry, I'm just so stressed about this release deadline tomorrow. I shouldn't have snapped at you.
Can we just look at the build log together and start over?
